info.title: Audiobook Librarian Lite API
info.description:
API for the Audiobook Librarian **lite** server: a self-hosted sync backend for the Audiobook Librarian apps.

Lite stores listening events, playback positions, bookmarks, tags, goals and badges for its own users, and nothing else. It hosts **no book catalog** — no books, authors, series, genres, covers, downloads or imports — and it never contacts or shares data with a full Audiobook Librarian server.

**Book identity.** Because there is no catalog there are no numeric book ids. Every endpoint that refers to a book identifies it by the pair `title` + `author`, sent as query parameters or body fields. Clients built against the full server may still send `bookId` on sync payloads; it is accepted and ignored.

Authentication uses opaque bearer tokens returned by the login and OTP endpoints. An account created by self-service signup starts at role `unverified` and is refused (403) by every authenticated endpoint until an administrator approves it.

BearerAuth.description: Authentication using Bearer tokens. After logging in, include the token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`

refreshToken.description: Refresh token (same as authToken in this implementation)

AuthSession.description: An authenticated session. `authToken`, `refreshToken` and `token` all carry the same bearer token value.

DayTimelineSegment.description: One continuous stretch of listening, keyed by title and author.

EarnedBadge.description: A badge the caller earned during this request.

code.description: Error code for identifying the type of error

email.description: Email address to send the reset link to

ListeningEvent.description: A single playback event. Lite hosts no book catalog, so an event is keyed by `bookTitle` + `bookAuthor` rather than by a numeric book id. Clients built against the full server may instead send `bookId` with the same strings carried in `metadata.fallbackTitle` / `metadata.fallbackAuthor`; lite reads the identity from there and ignores the id. Responses always carry `bookTitle` / `bookAuthor`.

id.description: Client-generated event id; re-sending a known id is a no-op.

bookPath.description: Client-local path. Accepted and not stored as a column; clients that need it back carry the same value inside `metadata`, which does round-trip.

bookId.description: Accepted from full-server clients and ignored. Lite identifies books by title and author.

email.description: User's email address (required if username not provided)

username.description: User's username (required if email not provided)

ProgressItem.description: One book's progress as the client currently holds it.

bookId.description: Accepted from full-server clients and echoed back; never used as identity.

title.description: Required in practice — an item without one is skipped.

ProgressSyncItem.description: Playback progress for one book. Lite has no book catalog, so `title` is the identity; `bookId` is echoed back untouched for full-server clients and never used to look anything up. An item with no title is skipped rather than failing the batch.

bookId.description: Accepted and echoed back so a full-server client can match the update to its own record. Never used as identity.

ProgressUpdate.description: Server-held progress that is newer than what the client sent.

bookId.description: The client's own id, echoed back.

email.description: Email address of the account being reset

system.description: System-wide tags, visible to everyone. Admin-managed.

groups.description: Tags visible only to members of each group the caller belongs to.

book_id.description: Accepted from full-server clients and ignored.

actual_duration_ms.description: Real listening time; preferred over the wall-clock span.

photo_url.description: User's profile photo URL. If not set, defaults to cover of last completed book

UserRole.description: Lite has exactly three roles: unverified, user, and admin. Unverified accounts may authenticate but cannot use sync endpoints.

UserStatistics.description: Lifetime totals over the caller's synced listening sessions.

ValidationError.description: The request body or query string failed validation

get.description: Returns a list of all available API endpoints, grouped by resource, along with links to documentation.

delete.summary: Schedule deletion of the authenticated account
delete.description: Requires a current email verification code. Revokes access immediately and permanently deletes the account and associated data after 30 days unless the user cancels using the emailed link.

get.description: Returns all groups with member counts. Admin only.

post.description: Creates a new group. Admin only.

get.description: Returns a group with its members. Admin only.

post.summary: Add a member to a group
post.description: Adds a user to a group by user id. Admin only.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a group
delete.description: Removes a user from a group. Admin only.

get.description: Admin only. Lists accounts with optional substring search over name, email and username.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against name, email and username.

post.description: Admin only. Creates an account with a random password and `must_change_password` set, then (unless `send_otp_email` is false) emails the welcome message carrying a sign-in code as the user's first login.
Admin only. Emails a fresh one-time sign-in code to an already-onboarded user.
Admin only. Sends the welcome message — sign-in code plus app connect links — as the user's first usable login. Unlike send-otp, which resends a code to a user who has already onboarded.

Admin only. Approves a self-service signup sitting at role `unverified`, assigns it a real role (default `user`) and sends the welcome email. Until this runs the account can authenticate but every sync endpoint answers 403.

200.description: User verified, or already verified (in which case no `user` is returned).

post.description: Request a password reset email. Alias for POST /forgot-password.
Authenticate and receive a Bearer token. Alias for POST /login.

email: The email must be a valid email address.

post.description: Emails a 6-digit code plus a magic link. Always answers 200 with the same generic message whether or not the address exists, so the endpoint cannot be used to enumerate accounts. Rate limited per email and IP.

allow_signup.description: Create an account for an unknown address instead of silently doing nothing.

200.description: Code sent (or silently ignored for an unknown address)

post.summary: Exchange a sign-in code for a token
post.description: Send either `email` + `code` (the typed 6-digit code) or `token` (the magic-link token). Returns a bearer token on success. An account still at role `unverified` is refused with 403 `ACCOUNT_PENDING_APPROVAL`.
Register a new user account. Alias for POST /register.

message.example: Account created. Waiting for admin approval.

value.message: Account created. Waiting for admin approval.

name: The name field is required.
email: The email must be a valid email address.
password: The password must be at least 8 characters.

email: The email has already been taken.

username: The username has already been taken.

post.description: Reset password using a token. Alias for POST /reset-password.
Authenticated. Sets a password and clears the `must_change_password` flag left by an OTP or admin-created login.

get.description: Returns all bookmarks matching the given title/author for the authenticated user. Lite has no book catalog, so books are identified by title/author, not an id.

post.description: Creates a new bookmark identified by title/author (lite has no book catalog).

delete.description: Deletes a specific bookmark using only its ID.

get.summary: Get tags for a title/author across all visible scopes
get.description: Lite has no book catalog, so tags are keyed by title and author instead of a book id. Returns system tags (everyone), group tags (for groups the caller belongs to), and the caller's own private tags.

put.summary: Replace tags for one scope on a title/author
put.description: Replaces the tag list for a single scope (system/group/user) on the given title/author. System tags require admin; group tags require membership in the target group; user tags are always allowed for the caller's own private list.

403.description: Not allowed to set tags at this scope

post.description: Check if an account is still pending approval or has been verified. Returns 403 if pending, 200 if account is ready for login.

get.description: Returns devices for the authenticated user.

put.description: Update a device for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a device for the authenticated user.

post.description: If an account exists for the provided email address, a password reset email will be sent.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's sent and/or received friend invitations

post.summary: Send a friend invitation to an existing user by email

422.description: No account with that email, already friends, or a pending invite already exists

get.summary: List pending received invitations not yet shown to the user (for an in-app snackbar)

post.summary: Create a short-lived QR join token for the authenticated user
Join a friend via a scanned QR token

422.description: Token invalid, expired, already used, or self-scan

get.summary: List completed or expired custom-range listening goals

200.description: History of custom-range listening goals that have ended or been deactivated

get.summary: Get the books/days contributing to a listening goal's progress

get.description: Returns detailed health status including database connectivity, book format compliance, and series format validation. No authentication required.

Returns what features this server supports. Capability names match the client's BackendCapability vocabulary; POSITION_SYNC and ACHIEVEMENTS are older spellings of HISTORY_SYNC and BADGES and are still sent for older clients. Clients that receive 404 from this endpoint should assume the lite defaults: HISTORY_SYNC, STATS, BOOKMARKS_SYNC, BADGES.

get.summary: Basic ping endpoint for uptime checks
get.description: Returns a simple OK response to verify the API is responding. No authentication required.
Validates API responses against the OpenAPI specification. Checks books list, single book, and array format compliance. No authentication required.

post.summary: Authenticate user and get access token
post.description: Authenticates a user with email/username and password. Returns an access token that must be included in subsequent API requests.

email: The email must be a valid email address.

post.description: Logs out the current user by invalidating their access token. The token will no longer be valid for API requests.

get.description: Returns the complete OpenAPI specification for the API.

put.summary: Register a push notification token for the authenticated user

get.description: Returns daily aggregation of reading time and sessions.
Returns current and longest reading streaks and last active date.
Returns lifetime reading statistics and current streaks for the user.

post.description: Creates a new user account. The account will be created with 'unverified' status and requires admin approval before the user can log in.

email: The email must be a valid email address.

post.description: Reset a user's password using a reset token.

Record one finished listening session. The session is keyed by `title` + `author`; `book_id` is accepted from full-server clients and ignored. An event's type may be sent as either `type` or the client's `event_type`. Earning a badge is evaluated after the session is stored, and any new badges come back in `badges_earned`.

422.description: Validation failed (a session needs a title and author)

get.description: Listening totals bucketed over a date range, optionally narrowed to certain weekdays.
The listening segments of a single local day, resolved in the given timezone.
List synced bookmarks for the authenticated device/user.

post.description: Store/update a synced bookmark.

get.description: Get synced bookmarks for a specific book, identified by title/author.

delete.description: Delete a synced bookmark by stringId.

post.description: Push locally recorded events and pull events other devices have synced, in one call. Events are keyed by title and author. Re-sending an event id already stored is ignored, so retries are safe. Earning a badge is evaluated whenever the batch contains a SESSION_END, and any new badges come back in `badgesEarned`.

lastSyncTimestamp.description: Cursor: return events synced at or after this epoch-ms value.

syncAfter.description: Overrides `lastSyncTimestamp` as the pull cursor; use the `nextSyncAfter` from the previous response.

nextSyncAfter.description: Cursor to send as `syncAfter` on the next call.

get.description: Get listening events for a specific book, identified by title/author.
Aggregated listening totals for the caller. Pass `title` and `author` together to scope the totals to a single book; lite has no numeric book ids.
List synced positions for the authenticated device/user.

post.description: Store/update a synced position.

get.description: Get synced position for a book, identified by title/author.

post.description: Push the client's per-book progress and receive back anything the server holds a newer copy of. Books are keyed by `title` + `author`; an item with no title is skipped rather than failing the batch. `bookId` is accepted from full-server clients and echoed back on any update so they can match it to their own record, but it is never used to look anything up.

get.description: Returns the most frequently used system-scope tags, for autocomplete suggestions. Group and user tag names are never included.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tags to return (default 20, max 50)

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information
